hooks.command: bash -c 'J=/usr/bin/jq; [ -x "$J" ] || J=$(command -v jq) || exit 0; f=$("$J" -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$f" in *.html|*.htm) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; H="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/htmlhint"; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; out=$("$H" --nocolor "$f" 2>&1); [ $? -eq 1 ] || exit 0; printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qE "found [1-9][0-9]* errors?" || exit 0; { echo "htmlhint found problems in $f (some may predate this edit):"; printf "%s\n" "$out" | head -n 60; } >&2; exit 2'
